shared_elements: bird or bird-like animal in profile
horizontal bands or rows of repeated signs/motifs
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces include profile birds/animals and repeated sign-like motifs arranged in horizontal rows or bands. The major difference is that B is dominated by an arched stela-like composition with human figures worshipping a central disc above long ordered rows of script-like signs, whereas A is a stacked arrangement of large isolated animal and abstract motifs without the same central human-disc scene or dense textual field.
